fields.evidence: 2276 assert string 'timer->time_remaining >= 0' at countdown_timer_set_time_remaining @0x12bf47; @0x12bf40 stores a dword and countdown_timer_get_time_remaining @0x12bddb tests its sign
PAL countdown_timer declares unsigned long last_update_time; 2276 countdown_timer_get_time_remaining @0x12bdbc reads a dword at +0x04 and @0x12bddd stores the current tick there

notes: PAL names +0x04 last_update_time. Keep the C field name mechanical because no 2276 assert or PDB name for that field has been found; its signed comparison is an interpretation of the unsigned stored tick.
Ghidra MCP was unavailable, so 2276 evidence came from local pristine-XBE disassembly.
